purpose: Define the minimum data-integrity evidence a player-availability source must provide before LevLine may consider historical or prospective model research at a pregame horizon.

qualification_tests.stable_identity: At least 99.5% of status rows in each validation season map unambiguously to stable LevLine/nflverse player IDs; unresolved identities remain missing rather than name-guessed.
qualification_tests.target_season_coverage: Point-in-time evidence must cover every intended validation season, including 2025, before a 2022-2025 backtest is allowed. A source may still qualify for a narrower prospective or 2026-only scope when its actual coverage supports that scope.
qualification_tests.revision_semantics: The source must prove whether historical queries expose the status that existed at T-120 rather than only the latest/final retrospective status. If revisions cannot be reconstructed, fail closed for that historical scope.
qualification_tests.timestamp_parseability: At least 99.5% of rows used for horizon qualification must have a parseable source-effective/update timestamp or equivalent versioned snapshot timestamp.
qualification_tests.pregame_only: Rows learned after the tested game kickoff cannot be used to construct that game's availability feature.
qualification_tests.no_realized_participation_proxy: Actual snaps, actual participation, postgame workload and final inactive status learned after kickoff are prohibited substitutes.
qualification_tests.missingness_reporting: Per-season/team/position missingness and source outages must be reported; missing status cannot silently mean healthy/active.
qualification_tests.revision_audit_sample: For a manually reviewed sample spanning multiple teams/weeks/seasons, reconstruct source states at several pregame times and compare with archived/versioned evidence.
qualification_tests.reproducibility: The exact source revision or immutable local capture used by a research row must be recoverable and independently auditable.

active_zero_cost_candidate_priority.reason: Verified public snapshot history begins 2026-02-01 and supports all-position player-state auditing with conservative Git-commit availability bounds. It cannot reconstruct 2025 and therefore cannot unlock a 2022-2025 historical availability backtest.
Strong current reference, but rendered historical pages alone do not establish stable IDs or exact T-120 revision state.

inactive_nonzero_cost_candidates.reason: Potentially strong technical candidate, but inactive under the current zero-cost research policy.
Potential secondary technical candidate, but inactive under the current zero-cost research policy.

fail_closed_outcomes: no historical availability model fitting when target-season point-in-time evidence is incomplete
no availability probability feature when identity/timing/reproducibility gates fail
no imputation from realized current-game snaps
current status may remain explanatory context when its data integrity supports that narrower role
rights_metadata_policy: Licensing, usage-rights and redistribution metadata may be recorded for governance but never changes technical qualification.
